verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI docs list `lms server start` and `lms server stop` under "Start and stop the local server", so the product directly delivers this story. The headless llmster daemon also supports GUI-free server use. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the start/stop commands specifically, and documentation of server start options such as port or network binding flags.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: Start and stop the local server ... lms server start / lms server stop

lms server start
lms server stop
llmster is the headless version of LM Studio, no desktop app required.
